address: Avenida Peña de Francia 12, Vecinos, 37456, Spain
bio: This house, located in the heart of Campo Charro, has been in the hands of the same family... since 1916! Here, each dish is a tribute to the land and the efforts of those who cultivate or work it, always with great dedication and an unequivocal dose of passion. The chef at the helm, Cristina Martín, builds her proposal around the best produce, seasonality and the authenticity of the flavours that come from nature, so that we can enjoy gastronomy in its purest state!...
